overview: The Human Rights Commission approved prior meeting minutes, heard introductions and questions from nine applicants seeking appointment to five commission vacancies, and discussed ongoing efforts to review the municipal human rights ordinance.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to approve the prior meeting minutes.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: Director of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Frances Nwajei shared upcoming community events, including a recovery kickball game and tabling at the Mystic River Celebration.

items.title: Applicant Introductions
items.summary: Nine prospective applicants introduced themselves and outlined their backgrounds and interests in joining the commission.

items.title: Safe Medford and Ordinance Review Update
items.summary: Commissioners received an update on work by a Safe Medford committee reviewing the city's human rights ordinance to draft recommended updates.

items.title: Commission Operations and Selection Process Discussion
items.summary: Applicants and commissioners discussed the commission's scope, meeting accessibility, regional coalitions, and the process for recommending five applicants to the mayor.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: The floor was opened for public participation with no comments offered.
